messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

- an allergy to tamsulosin or any of its ingredients
- an allergy to sulfa drugs
- kidney problems
- liver problems
- low blood pressure (hypotension)
Also tell your doctor if you are planning to have cataract or glaucoma surgery.
Ask your doctor about prostate cancer screening before starting tamsulosin and at regular intervals afterwards.
Tamsulosin is not approved for use in women or in children.

The relation 'has recommendation' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug requires the medical action or procedure specified by the object entity to be performed.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used in': The subject drug is utilized in the medical procedure or clinical context specified by the object entity.
B. 'may be used for': The subject drug can be used for the purpose or indication specified by the object entity.
C. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'used after': The subject drug is typically used following the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'requires adjustment of': The subject drug necessitates changes or modifications to the treatment or dosage specified by the object entity.
